messages.content: You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If hotel Wi-Fi is complimentary but I paid for wired internet, can I expense that?
No, if complimentary connectivity is available, additional charges are not reimbursable under Section 4.4.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What’s the maximum I can spend per night on a hotel in a Tier 3 city?
The maximum nightly rate for Tier 3 cities is $185 (Section 6).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I book a domestic trip 6 days in advance if the CFO says it's okay?
No, exceptions for domestic trip booking windows require both manager and travel-ops approval, not just the CFO (Section 2).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If the preferred carrier's fare is 12% higher than the cheapest option, should I still book it?
No, you should only use the preferred carrier if the fare is within 10% of the lowest available. See Section 7.2.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
My team dinner with a client cost $180 per person. Allowed?
No — client entertainment is capped at $150 per person (Section 8). Over that requires an exception with VP approval.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense a cocktail at dinner during my domestic trip?
Alcohol is not reimbursable on domestic trips unless it is part of approved client entertainment, per Section 4.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
My 3-night domestic trip will cost $2,150. What do I need to get approved?
This is over the $2,000 cap for domestic 3+ night trips by less than 15%, so VP approval is required (Section 3).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need an itemized receipt for a $20 cab fare?
Itemized documentation is required for receipts of $25 or more (Section 9). For $20 a summary entry is acceptable, though itemization is always preferred.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I get reimbursed if I book first class with my own money?
No, first class is never reimbursable regardless of how it is paid for. This is detailed in Section 7.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I pay cash to upgrade my flight to business class, will WWI cover that?
No, cash upgrades are specifically non-reimbursable as stated in Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
I forgot to submit a receipt within 30 days. Can I still get reimbursed?
Yes, but only with VP approval and a written exception in the expense report (Section 9).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my flight lands at 12:30 AM and I have a meeting that morning, is that allowed?
No, you should avoid arrivals after midnight local time when a morning meeting is scheduled. See Section 7.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What's the max hotel nightly rate in Tokyo?
Tokyo is Tier 1: $325 per night maximum (Section 6).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What do I do if I need to book a domestic trip last minute for an urgent client meeting?
You need manager and travel-ops approval for an emergency travel exception to book a domestic trip within 7 days (Section 2).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Are train tickets between cities reimbursable as ground transport?
Yes, train travel is considered reimbursable ground transport per Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Which cities are considered Tier 1 for hotel rates?
Tier 1 cities include New York City, San Francisco, London, and Tokyo (Section 6).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is a limousine service reimbursable if it's the only option available?
Limousine or luxury class services require manager approval for reimbursement, as described in Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
I accidentally charged a soda from the minibar to my room. Can I submit that for reimbursement?
No, minibar charges are not reimbursable as outlined in Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Am I allowed to fly business class on a 4-hour flight?
No. Business class is only allowed for flights longer than 6 hours and requires VP approval at booking time (Section 7.1).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my hotel offers a spa package bundled with the room, can I expense the full amount?
No, spa charges are considered personal entertainment and are not reimbursable, even if bundled. Refer to Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
My hotel in a small town is $200 per night. Is that allowed without extra approval?
No, for Tier 3 cities, the cap is $185/night, so manager approval is needed for up to 20% over the cap (Section 6).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
I need to book a domestic flight for next week, but it's only 5 days away. Is that allowed?
Domestic trips must be booked at least 7 days in advance unless you have an approved emergency travel exception (Section 2).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I choose a non-preferred airline if it helps me get more frequent flyer miles?
No, you should not book a carrier primarily to accumulate miles, even though personal mileage accounts are allowed. See Section 7.2.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my hotel in Seattle costs $250 per night, do I need approval?
Yes, since Seattle is Tier 2 with a $235/night cap, you need manager approval for rates up to 20% over the cap (Section 6).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What is the max nightly hotel rate in Berlin?
Berlin is Tier 2: $235 per night maximum, per Section 6. Up to 20% over needs manager approval; more than that needs VP approval.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I get reimbursed for airport parking if I lost my receipt?
No, you must submit a receipt within 30 days of the trip return to be reimbursed for airport parking per Section 4.2.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is it okay to expense travel insurance if I buy it myself for a work trip?
No, travel insurance purchased independently is not reimbursable according to Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If the hotel offers free basic Wi-Fi but charges for premium speed, can I expense the upgrade?
No, only non-complimentary hotel Wi-Fi is reimbursable; upgrades beyond complimentary service are not covered by Section 4.4.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I rent a luxury car if economy is sold out?
Only with manager approval. Section 4.1 limits the default to economy or intermediate class.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What's the daily airport parking limit for expenses?
You can expense up to $25 per day for airport parking according to Section 4.2.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is hotel Wi-Fi reimbursable if the hotel charges a daily fee?
Yes, hotel Wi-Fi is reimbursable when it is not complimentary per Section 4.4.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What's the maximum budget for a 2-night domestic business trip?
The default cap for a domestic trip of 1–2 nights is $1,200, as stated in Section 3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I rent a luxury SUV for my trip if my manager approves it?
Yes, with manager approval, luxury class rental cars are reimbursable under Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense airport parking for $35 per day if that's what the lot charges?
You will only be reimbursed up to $25 per day for airport parking per Section 4.2; any amount above that is not covered.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I get reimbursed for the spa treatment I had at the hotel during my business trip?
No, spa charges are listed as non-reimbursable expenses in Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
I have to land after midnight before a morning meeting. Is that allowed?
Avoid arrivals after midnight when a morning-of meeting is scheduled (Section 7.3). Rebook for an earlier arrival or move the meeting.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my 4-night domestic trip will cost $2,300, what approval do I need?
Since this exceeds the $2,000 cap for domestic 3+ night trips by more than 15%, you need CFO approval per Section 3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is in-flight Wi-Fi reimbursable?
Yes, on flights of 2 hours or longer (Section 4.4).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If self-park is full and I have to use valet, do I need to provide proof?
Yes, valet parking is only reimbursable when self-park is unavailable, so you should document this in your expense report as required by Section 4.2.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense cocktails at dinner if I'm entertaining clients?
Yes, alcohol is reimbursable when it's part of an approved client entertainment meal, as specified in Section 8.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I have a $26 expense but only have a summary credit card slip, will that be accepted?
No, you must provide an itemized receipt for any expense of $25 or more per Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need to submit itemized receipts for daily meal per-diem claims?
Per-diem meals do not require itemized receipts, but the limits and alcohol restrictions in Section 4.3 still apply.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What's the budget cap for a 5-night international trip?
$3,500 total (flight + hotel + ground transport), per Section 3. Over by up to 15% needs VP approval; over by more than 15% needs CFO approval.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If all economy cars are unavailable, can I upgrade to a luxury rental car and get reimbursed?
You may rent a luxury class car if economy is unavailable, but you must have manager approval as required by Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
I'm attending a conference in Boston for three days. What's my daily meal limit?
For domestic trips, the meals per-diem is $75 per day according to Section 4.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need VP approval to fly business class on a 7-hour trip?
Yes, business class is only allowed on flights over 6 hours and always requires VP approval at booking. Refer to Section 7.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense a luxury car rental if I get a verbal okay from my manager but no written approval?
No, manager approval must be properly documented for luxury class rentals. See Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Are taxes and ground transport included in the per-trip budget caps?
Yes, the caps include flight, hotel, and ground transport (Section 3).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What's the meals per-diem when traveling internationally?
$95 per day for international travel, per Section 4.3. Alcohol is not included except for approved client entertainment.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is an itemized receipt required for a $120 client lunch with drinks?
Yes, all client entertainment expenses require itemized receipts regardless of the amount, as stated in Section 8.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my flight is exactly 2 hours, can I submit the Wi-Fi expense?
Yes, in-flight Wi-Fi on flights of 2 hours or more is reimbursable per Section 4.4.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is it okay to submit my hotel receipt 32 days after I get back?
Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of your trip return; after that, reimbursement requires VP approval and a written exception. See Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
What happens if I forget to get travel-ops approval before booking a last-minute international trip?
Booking international travel less than 21 days in advance without both manager and travel-ops approval is not compliant with policy (Section 2).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense childcare costs while I'm traveling for work?
No. Childcare is listed as non-reimbursable under Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
How much can I spend on an international trip that's just 2 nights?
For international trips of 1–3 nights, the cap is $2,500 according to Section 3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
For a 5-night international trip, can I book if the total is $3,400?
Yes, the default cap for international trips of 4+ nights is $3,500 (Section 3), so $3,400 is within policy.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If the only available hotel in Tokyo is $350 per night, can I book it without manager approval?
No, for Tier 1 cities like Tokyo, manager approval is required if the rate exceeds the $325/night cap by up to 20% (Section 6).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is the budget cap inclusive of taxes and fees?
Yes — the per-trip cap in Section 3 covers flight, hotel, and ground transport totals including taxes and fees.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my childcare provider charges extra while I'm on a business trip, can I include that in my expenses?
No, childcare expenses are not reimbursable under Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense in-flight Wi-Fi on a 90-minute flight?
No, in-flight Wi-Fi is only reimbursable for flights of 2 hours or longer according to Section 4.4.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense hotel Wi-Fi if it's not complimentary?
Yes — hotel Wi-Fi is reimbursable when not included free (Section 4.4).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I get reimbursed for wine with my dinner if I'm not with clients?
No, alcohol is not reimbursable unless it's for approved client entertainment per Section 4.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If my international trip includes both business and personal days, do I get the per-diem for all days?
You may only claim the $95/day international per-diem for business travel days, as stated in Section 4.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I book a flight on a non-preferred carrier if it's cheaper?
Use preferred carriers when fare is within 10% of the cheapest option (Section 7.2). If a non-preferred carrier is more than 10% cheaper, you may book it.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I travel internationally for two days, how much can I claim for meals?
You can claim $95 per day for meals on international trips, as outlined in Section 4.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
How far in advance do I need to book a domestic trip?
At least 7 days in advance for domestic trips, per Section 2. Less than that requires manager and travel-ops approval as an emergency exception.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is it okay to book an international trip just 10 days before departure if my manager approves?
No, both manager and travel-ops approval are required for exceptions to the 21-day advance booking rule for international trips (Section 2).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I get reimbursed for taking a Lyft from the airport to my hotel?
Yes, rideshare services like Lyft are reimbursable for ground transport per Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is it okay to rent an intermediate class car for my business trip?
Yes, both economy and intermediate class rental cars are reimbursable without special approval, according to Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
My valet parking cost more than self-park. Can I expense it?
Only if self-park was unavailable; otherwise no (Section 4.2). Document the reason in your expense report notes.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need special approval to take a taxi from my hotel to a client meeting?
No, taxis are reimbursable ground transport and do not require special approval as stated in Section 4.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need to provide a list of everyone who attended the client dinner for reimbursement?
Yes, an attendee list is required along with the itemized receipt for client entertainment expenses, per Section 8.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need to provide an itemized receipt for a $24 meal?
No, only receipts for expenses of $25 or more require itemization. Refer to Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Am I allowed to book a same-day return flight if my meeting finishes at 5 PM?
No, same-day return is not required when the meeting ends after 4 PM local time. Refer to Section 7.3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I submit my receipts 45 days after my trip, do I need special approval?
No, as long as you submit within 60 days of your trip return, no special approval is needed. See Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I use mileage upgrades to fly business?
Yes. Mileage upgrades are allowed; only cash-paid upgrades are non-reimbursable (Section 5).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I forget to upload my $30 meal receipt within 30 days, can I just add it to next month's report?
Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of your trip return date; late submissions require special approval. See Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I get reimbursed for a 4-night international trip costing $4,000 if my VP approves?
No, since $4,000 is more than 15% over the $3,500 cap, you need CFO approval according to Section 3.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need to submit receipts if I only claim $50 per person for a client event?
Yes, an itemized receipt and attendee list must be submitted for all client entertainment expenses, per Section 8.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
My one-day domestic trip is $1,400. Is that OK?
No — the cap for a 1–2 night domestic trip is $1,200 (Section 3). Over by up to 15% needs VP approval; over by more than 15% needs CFO approval.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense airport parking at SAN for a business trip?
Yes — airport parking is reimbursable up to $25/day under Section 4.2. Submit the receipt within 30 days of the trip return date.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I pay cash at the airport to upgrade my economy ticket to business and get reimbursed?
No, cash upgrades are specifically excluded from reimbursement. See Section 5.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is alcohol reimbursable if I go out with colleagues but no clients are present?
No, alcohol is only reimbursable during meals with clients as outlined in Section 8; it is not reimbursable for internal team events.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Do I need to keep my airport parking receipt if it was under $25?
Receipts are required for all reimbursable airport parking expenses, and must be submitted within 30 days, per Section 4.2.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I book first class if it's the only available seat for my business trip?
No, first class is never reimbursable under any circumstance. See Section 7.1.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Is valet parking ever reimbursable?
Valet parking is only reimbursable if self-park is unavailable, as stated in Section 4.2.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I submit a photo of my taxi receipt using my phone for my expense report?
Yes, mobile photos of receipts are accepted for submission according to Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If I stay in Berlin and the hotel charges $240 per night, what do I need to do?
You need manager approval since Berlin is Tier 2 with a $235/night cap and your rate is within 20% over (Section 6).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I book premium economy for a 5-hour domestic flight?
No. Premium economy is allowed only for flights of 6 hours or more (Section 7.1).
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
Can I claim in-flight Wi-Fi if I forgot to ask for a receipt?
No, you need a receipt for reimbursement as required by Section 4.4 and Section 9.
You answer WWI policy questions. Concise.
If our client meal was $160 per person, can I still get reimbursed?
No, the per-person cap for client entertainment is $150; exceeding this amount is not allowed under Section 8.
